summary.text: Rebecca Raymer is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 15 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A nurse, she worked as a case management nurse with HCA Healthcare.

paragraphs.text: Rebecca Raymer's career experience includes working as a case management nurse with HCA Healthcare.
She has served as vice president of the Butler County chapter of Stop the Landfill LLC and as a precinct officer with the Butler County Republican Party.
She took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, as the successor to Melinda Gibbons Prunty.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Health and Family Services, Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations, and Local Government committees and was vice chair of the State Government Committee.
The Republican primary for her seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
